meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + review-work reviewers + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发任务拆成独立可合并的PR并自动完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次实现功能都要手动创建、审查、合并多个PR
copy.tagline_en: Break down tasks into atomic PRs and automate the full lifecycle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create, review, and merge multiple PRs for each feature

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你完成从创建分支、编写代码、手动测试、创建 PR、等待审核到自动合并的完整流程。它会将一个大任务拆成多个小 PR，并同时处理它们。
howto.when: 当你要求“创建一个 PR”、“实现并提交 PR”、“处理这个并做成 PR”、“实现 issue”、“把这个落地为 PR”、“拆成原子 PR”、“并行 PR”、“work-with-pr”、“PR 工作流”、“端到端实现”，或者上下文暗示需要交付 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我实现这个功能并创建一个 PR。
say.note: Claude 会拆任务、写代码、手动测试、创建 PR。

say.text: 把这个 issue 拆成几个小 PR 并行处理。
say.note: Claude 会分解任务，同时创建多个 PR。

say.text: 为这个改动创建一个 PR，并等待审核通过后合并。
